name: Timex Group India Ltd
about: Timex Group India Limited is a group company of Tanager Group B.V. (formerly known as Timex Group B.V.). The Co is engaged in manufacturing and trading of watches and rendering of related after sales service. The Company also provides information and technology support services to the Group Companies. [1][2]
keyPoints:
History
Co entered India in 1988 as a joint venture with Jayna Times Industries Ltd until 1990. In 1990, co entered into a JV with Titan which ended in 2000. Co got listed in 1994. Timex Group is America’s Oldest Watchmaker, established in 1854 in Connecticut[1][2]

pros: Company is expected to give good quarter
Company has delivered good profit growth of 81.1% CAGR over last 5 years
cons: Stock is trading at 30.5 times its book value
Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -15.0%
